'''Michael Sneed''' (DeckTech handle '''admiralpiett''')<ref name="dt-24783">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24783 Subterranean Homesick Alien], DeckTech (Michael "admiralpiett" Sneed, 2 August 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24783/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24783/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009033752/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24783/ Wayback Machine].</ref> won the [[Tulsa Mini-Open]] with a [[Dark]] [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal!]] list (''Subterranean Homesick Alien'').
